headline: Colombian Gas Group Promigas Reports 24% Drop in Nine-Month Profit
summary: Colombian gas group Promigas announced that shareholder profit fell 24.3% to approximately $202 million over nine months as interest expenses on new debt rose 23.7%.
why: Promigas is a major Latin American natural gas transportation and distribution utility whose earnings reflect the impact of higher financing costs on leveraged energy infrastructure.

impacts.name: Promigas
impacts.why: Higher interest expenses on new debt caused a 24.3% drop in shareholder profit.
